sources.excerpt: Combined bot/Happiness Engineer chats in Support
Getting help is simpler with a single conversations flow that combines support bots and Happiness Engineers.

claims: One unified list and detail flow replaces separate bot and Happiness Engineer entries
Bot details use inline chat while replyable HE details use a reply sheet and closed HE details show a closed banner
List API errors surface as errors rather than empty lists
Input clears while sending and is restored only on failure
Draft and attachment state is cleared when a different conversation opens
Application-owned repository methods map combined-conversation list, detail, reply, and bot-create endpoints
